cases.limits: Authority-gate unit vector. Does not assert that the existing source schema retains this lineage or that all target-native checks could pass after correctly applied ordered controls.

conservative_rule: Require authenticated exact-scope authoritative observation after all object reads and before emit, pending=false, active control epoch equals immutable original admission epoch, and exact decimal-string version equality. Null head means0 only with proven same active epoch and baseline; NULL/missing admission is UNKNOWN. Any control after admission conservatively hides even unrelated sessions. Retain all target/native privacy checks.
coverage_requirements: Run selection/reset failed-fence cases for list,metadata,turns,events,timing and each other buffered-emitting surface.
Gate occurs after all S3 reads and before first response content is emitted, including streaming.
Service endpoint not reachable as public route; forged public requests and identity substitution refuse.
Authority result is request-local and exact-scope, not reused across another request/page/user.
A later control after final authority read has normal read linearization semantics; fixture does not demand impossible perpetual validity.
Conservative comparator must be identical for list,turns,metadata in rollout1. Other routes remain canonical-only. Direct service endpoint is internal-only.
identity_policy: All fixture identifiers synthetic. Verified server identity, never client-provided tenant or head. No acceptedAt timestamp-based reset shortcut.
limitations: No endpoint or RPC contract is invented by this file.
No database migration, local PG execution, production query or observed disclosure claimed.
Passing a standalone fixture replay does not validate real endpoint, SQL, signing or service-binding wiring; integration tests must drive implementation.

ABA vector is a required semantic negative; existing Neon control head stores only latest payload, so historical last-revocation availability needs separate source proof. Missing lineage must refuse, not assume zero.
No precise last-revocation branch is qualified; endpoint head-only response cannot reconstruct erased historical tombstones.
purpose: Contract-neutral causal fixture for R2 final authority gate; builders adapt transport field names without weakening ordering/assertions.
